title: Domain Registrations: Domain Care Refund on a Restore Charge
content:
## Refunds desk worksheet — Domain Care price match on a restore charge (Domain Registrations)

**Which charge.** The most recent restore charge is the restore charge line of the domain with the latest charge date; a domain is never billed two such charges on one day, and an older restore charge is never price-matched. The price match applies only where that charge was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal; a most recent restore charge billed outside those dates, or paid from account credit, has no price-match refund.

**Years the charge covered.** The renewal years booked on that restore charge line.

**Domain Care credits.** The Domain Care credits of a restore charge are the amounts named as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, added together, each read from the account's records on the day of the price match.

**Refund amount.** The price-match refund is the charge's Domain Care credits, never more than the amount billed on the charge, rounded half up to the cent, and nothing is refunded where those credits come to zero.

| Worksheet line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A | Amount billed on the most recent restore charge |
| B | Domain Care credits of that charge, added together, as of the day of the price match |
| Refund | The lower of A and B, rounded half up to the cent; nothing where B is zero or the charge is outside the dates or payment methods above |

**Hypothetical worked case** (amounts invented for illustration): a restore charge of USD 160.30 billed on 9 August 2023 by PayPal, the domain's latest restore charge line, with Domain Care credits on the day of the price match of USD 4.10. Refund: USD 4.10. Had the credits come to zero, nothing would be refunded; had the same charge been billed on 2 December 2025, or paid from account credit, it would carry no price match at all.

**Cap illustration (hypothetical):** credits of USD 20.00 against a charge of USD 18.00 give a refund of USD 18.00.
